NoirPanther server **0.1.7-r4** — built from Stump **0.1.7**, fork revision 4. **Security
release — please update.**

## Security

- **Privileged account fields.** A missing authorization check allowed a signed-in user to
  change privileged fields of their own account (permissions, age restriction, session limit).
  Only the server owner can change them now. The flaw comes from upstream Stump 0.1.7.
  _If untrusted people have accounts on your server, review your users' permissions after
  updating (Settings → Users)._
- **Per-user content rules did not hide books** in any NoirPanther build since the Stump 0.1.7
  merge (`0.1.7-vint-0.5.0` … `0.1.7-r3`): series and libraries were filtered, but the books
  themselves stayed visible in lists, search and by direct link. Fixed, with a regression test.
- **Missing-files listing** of a library (file-system paths) was readable by every signed-in user
  → now requires `MANAGE_LIBRARY`.
- **Previous book-club discussions** were readable without being a member of a private club.
- **Metadata overview** (genres, authors, publishers… used by filters and editors) listed values
  of books hidden from the caller → now limited to the books the caller can see.

No database or API changes. `scripts/noirpanther/authz_check.py` re-runs these checks against a
test server.
